newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine oilseeds dampened by U.S. rain talk.
newsitem.headline: Argentine oilseeds dampened by U.S. rain talk.

text.p: Argentine cash grain prices were quietly firmer but oilseeds weakened on the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Wednesday, after talk of rainfall in the U.S. Midwest dampened prices in Chicago.

Spot soybeans were $2 a tonne weaker and new crop was $2 to $3 a tonne weaker. New crop oilseeds were $1 weaker, but spot found some non-traditional buying interest in Buenos Aires for this-week delivery and rose about $2 a tonne.
January wheat firmed $1 and maize was helped by export demand, with spot and new crop maize both up $1-2 a tonne.
